accepted_debts.reason: One domain job: the fiction tree checks of one long-form project (ledger, interfaces, promises, continuity, voice), each script one surface; the model fiction_tree shows its rules, so size does not hide structure.
One trip-plan contract whose validators share the same indexes in one pass (sources, candidates, world checks, routes, fallbacks, fit); the model trip_feasibility binds its rules.
one decision table judged through one entry function: there is no composing function to split into steps, and halving the table makes two models replay the same function with no new information
